channel.title: Europa Research
channel.description: Europa Research is intelligence for a changing world — sharp, original reporting and analysis on AI and the technology, markets, and culture shifts reshaping how we live and work.

item.title: The Agentic Browser Arrives: Your Next Tab Does the Work
item.dc:creator: Europa AI Desk
item.description: A wave of AI-native browsers wants to move from showing you the web to acting on it — booking, buying, and researching on your behalf.

item.title: AI Weather Models Outpace the Forecast
item.dc:creator: Europa Research Staff
item.description: Machine-learning systems now rival — and often beat — the physics-based models that have run forecasting for decades, at a fraction of the compute.

item.title: The Memory Turn: AI Agents Start to Remember
item.dc:creator: Europa AI Desk
item.description: Persistent memory is becoming the feature that separates a useful assistant from a clever one that forgets you the moment the chat ends.

item.title: Proving What's Real: Content Credentials Go Mainstream
item.dc:creator: Europa Research Staff
item.description: As AI-generated media becomes indistinguishable from the real thing, a quiet standard for tamper-evident provenance is spreading across cameras, software, and platforms.

item.title: Solid-State Batteries Finally Ship: The Range Barrier Cracks
item.dc:creator: Europa Desk
item.description: After a decade of 'two years away,' solid-state cells are reaching real vehicles — promising more range, faster charging, and a lower fire risk.

item.title: October Baseball: The MLB Playoff Field Takes Shape
item.dc:creator: Europa Desk
item.description: As the regular season winds down, the postseason picture sharpens — a few juggernauts, a scramble of wild cards, and the usual promise that seeding means little once October starts.

item.title: The Distillation Boom: How Small Models Learn From Big Ones

item.title: The AI Data-Center Land Rush
item.dc:creator: Europa AI Desk
item.description: The race to train and serve AI has turned into a race for land, power, and cooling water — remaking the physical map of the internet.

item.title: Gold's Quiet Record Run
item.dc:creator: Europa Desk
item.description: The oldest asset in finance has had a remarkable year — and what's driving it says as much about the mood of the world as about the metal.

item.title: The Nine-Figure Researcher: Inside the AI Talent War
item.dc:creator: Europa Research Staff
item.description: A small pool of researchers can move the frontier — and the pay packages chasing them have reached numbers once reserved for star athletes.

item.title: Shadow AI: Your Employees Already Adopted It
item.dc:creator: Europa Research Staff
item.description: Long before most companies finished writing an AI policy, their staff were quietly pasting work into whatever tool helped — creating a governance problem no memo can undo.

item.title: The Bundle Is Back: Streaming Reconsolidates

item.description: After years of splintering into a dozen apps, streaming is quietly reassembling into bundles — the very thing cord-cutters fled cable to escape.

item.title: Voice Regains Its Voice: Conversational AI Gets Real

item.title: Opening the Black Box: Interpretability Grows Up

item.description: The effort to understand what happens inside a neural network is maturing from academic curiosity into a practical tool for safety and debugging.

item.title: The Copyright Reckoning Comes for AI Training

item.title: The Satellite-Internet Race Widens

item.title: The Eval Gap: Companies Are Shipping AI They Can't Measure

item.title: The Theater Strikes Back: A Record Summer Rewrites the Streaming Story
